written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Communication for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Communication Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #1001, the PDF in source_url. An option with no C-ID number has an empty c_id, which needs the migration 20261031120000_explore_option_no_c_id.sql before this file can be imported. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): none. No topic is shared. UC's overlap with this template sits inside choices: public speaking is one of UC's pick-3 and required here; intro to psychology and intro to sociology are in UC's pick-3 and in List B here. A shared status would claim more than either row says, so the descriptions point at each other. UC's intro to communication studies covers more than any single row here. Statistics is UC only. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/communication.json --dry-run
